components.title: IWorkflowEngine
components.rationale: Public workflow behavior port owned by the Engine.

components.title: WorkflowEngine facade
components.rationale: WorkflowEngine implements IWorkflowEngine and delegates to explicit application use cases.

components.title: Workflow engine use cases
components.rationale: Aggregate evidence view over the application boundary for start/recover/cancel/status/signal behavior; child components own the individual operation files.

components.title: StartRun application pipeline
components.rationale: Aggregate evidence view over admission, intent creation, dispatch, telemetry and failure policy; focused child components own their phase files.

components.title: IPlanIntegrityValidator
components.rationale: Named port view retained for navigation; admission is the owning behavioral classification for this file.

components.title: Stable + runtime public surfaces
components.rationale: Separates stable package exports, composition/runtime exports and testing-only surface.

components.title: Provider resilience + in-memory provider
components.rationale: Provider-side resilience wrapper and in-memory provider implementation; neither owns canonical lifecycle truth.

components.title: Recovery + provider selection application services
components.rationale: Application-layer recovery orchestration and provider selection outside the narrow workflow facade use-case folder.

components.title: Engine-local compatibility contracts
components.rationale: Engine-local contract/compatibility surface retained around canonical engine behavior and error vocabulary.

components.title: Core lifecycle runtime + projection
components.rationale: Core lifecycle helpers, facade construction, idempotency and snapshot projection supporting the public WorkflowEngine facade.

components.title: Engine domain service contracts + intent policy
components.rationale: Engine-owned domain service boundaries and start-run intent transition policy.

components.title: Metrics collection boundary
components.rationale: Engine metrics collection abstraction.

components.title: Outbox rate limiting
components.rationale: Engine-side outbox rate-limit policy and token-bucket implementation.

components.title: Supporting Engine ports
components.rationale: Authorization, projection, execution-context, maintenance and snapshot-staleness boundaries used by runtime composition.

components.title: Authorization + plan-reference security
components.rationale: Run access policy, authorization, plan-integrity/reference/URI validation and host-risk classification.

components.title: Run health, enrichment, maintenance + status services
components.rationale: Top-level operational Engine services outside start-run orchestration.

components.title: Run command + signal control
components.rationale: Canonical command and signal application services.

components.title: Run reconciliation + maintenance policies
components.rationale: Pending/dispatched intent reconciliation, stuck/orphaned-run maintenance and maintenance observability.

components.title: Signal transition policy
components.rationale: Signal transition guard independent from provider mechanics.

components.title: In-memory state implementations
components.rationale: In-memory state/outbox/intent implementations and state write/staleness policies used by testing and local composition.

components.title: Engine type surface
components.rationale: Engine-owned internal/public type aggregation.

components.title: Clock + error utilities
components.rationale: Small utility boundaries used by Engine services.

components.title: Intent reconciler worker
components.rationale: Engine-owned worker primitive for intent reconciliation; process hosting remains outside the package.
